stories.title: FRC to launch digital platform for sustainability reporting
stories.summary: The Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria will launch a digital platform to help companies prepare and file sustainability reports. Developed with Regulatory Compliance Readiness Advisors and SALI Technologies, the tool aims to provide a digital interface for filing readiness assessment documents. The council cites its 2011 Act as authority.

stories.title: FRC launches digital platform for sustainability reporting
stories.summary: The Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria is launching its National Digital Sustainability Reporting Platform on November 30. Developed with Regulatory Compliance Readiness Advisors and SALT Technologies, the FRC says the platform provides a seamless and efficient interface for companies to prepare and file sustainability reporting readiness assessment documents.

stories.title: Nigeria FRC to launch digital sustainability reporting platform - Traders Union
Two weeks to feedback on ISSB plans to improve nature disclosures
stories.summary: The International Sustainability Standards Board is seeking feedback on proposals to improve nature-related risk disclosures. The plans aim to help investors access material information by adding detail to existing IFRS S1 requirements. The board is currently weighing whether to issue a voluntary practice statement or a formal standard.

stories.title: SolidWorld Group Board Approves 2025 Sustainability Report - TipRanks
Integra Publishes Annual Sustainability Report - StreetInsider
UK government publishes sustainability assurance consultation outcome
stories.summary: The UK Department for Business and Trade has published its consultation outcome on third-party sustainability reporting assurance. The plan establishes a voluntary registration framework administered by the Financial Reporting Council to combat greenwashing and standardize environmental disclosures. The government intends to protect corporate reporting integrity across institutional supply chains.

stories.title: Integra Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report - TipRanks
HKEX to host board workshop on sustainability reporting
stories.summary: HKEX is hosting an interactive workshop to introduce board members to governance responsibilities under IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 standards. The session aims to provide tools for overseeing sustainability-related risks and financial disclosures. The workshop will be held in English on December 10 and Mandarin on December 16.

stories.title: Carbon credits provide income for Ugandan farmers
stories.summary: A tree-growing project in Uganda has allowed local farmers to earn money from carbon credits. One participant reported earning Shs 880,000 since 2021 from trees on his land, providing financial stability alongside future timber prospects. The payments offer a hedge against the unpredictability of traditional agricultural seasons.

stories.title: Tanzania targets $1 billion annual carbon revenue by 2050
stories.summary: Tanzania aims to earn $1 billion annually from carbon credit exports by 2050. The government reported $369 million in carbon trading revenue by 2025. To reach the billion-dollar goal, the country must convert its project pipeline into verified carbon reductions and ensure funds reach local communities.

stories.title: European Partnership Bill introduced to link carbon markets
stories.summary: The government has introduced the European Partnership Bill to implement agreements reached at the recent UK-EU summit. The legislation seeks powers to link the two sides' carbon markets and establish a sanitary agreement for food trade. Minister for European Relations Hamish Falconer is leading the measures.

stories.title: Puro.earth sets carbon removal record with ADM project
stories.summary: Puro.earth has issued 280,449 carbon removal credits for an industrial capture project at an Archer Daniels Midland ethanol facility. The issuance is the largest ever for a single engineered carbon dioxide removal project. The gas is captured during production and transported to Wyoming for permanent geological storage.

stories.title: EIB backs wind supply chain bonds with €100 million
stories.summary: The European Investment Bank is providing a €100 million counter-guarantee to support UniCredit trade finance for wind energy suppliers. The deal is expected to mobilise up to €1.6 billion in investment. Fincantieri is the first beneficiary, using the support for offshore wind vessels built by its subsidiary.

stories.title: Stakeholders propose reforms for Tanzanian carbon market
stories.summary: Stakeholders have proposed reforms to strengthen Tanzania’s carbon market. The discussion took place at the close of Climate Change Week in Dodoma, where officials from the National Carbon Monitoring Centre addressed the measurement, verification, reporting and registration processes required to manage the country's carbon trading activities.

stories.title: EU and UK to link carbon markets in 2028
stories.summary: The EU and UK have agreed to link their carbon markets by 2028. The government estimates the move could add £3.8 billion to the UK economy annually by 2040 and exempt British exports from the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism. The deal aims to create a larger, more liquid market.

stories.title: Ghana targets $68 million from forest carbon credits
stories.summary: Ghana expects to generate $68 million from the sale of 6.5 million tonnes of forest carbon credits, with buyers already committing $43 million. The Forestry Commission defines a credit as one tonne of carbon kept out of the air. The revenue figures were confirmed by the Lands Minister.

stories.title: Harnessing Carbon Credit Auctioning to top Uganda’s Foreign Exchange Earnings after Coffee and Gold by 2030 - PML Daily
COP31 ends without a deal in Antalya
stories.summary: The Antalya Climate Conference concluded without a final agreement after negotiations broke down over fossil fuel phase-out and climate finance. The summit, presided over by Türkiye and Australia, failed to reach political consensus, leaving the effectiveness of UN-led climate negotiations under renewed scrutiny.

stories.title: Researcher questions COP31 electrification goals
stories.summary: A University of Manchester researcher has warned that a global push for 35 percent electrification by 2035 could increase gas-fired power generation in the UK. Alice Larkin noted that without requirements for cleaner electricity, the proposal may lack the support needed to effectively reduce pollution.

stories.title: How Much Does a Failed Climate Summit Cost? For Turkey, Nearly $700 Million - Bloomberg
What next after COP31 failure? - Daily Nation
COP31 president blames EU for summit deadlock
stories.summary: Murat Kurum, president of COP31, has accused the European Union of attempting to dictate terms during the climate talks in Antalya. He described the failure to reach a final agreement as a manifestation of structural gridlock that has long hampered global decision-making mechanisms.

stories.title: How COP31’s unusual joint presidency unravelled - Climate Home News
Petrostates and the collapse of COP31
stories.summary: COP31 ended without an agreement for the first time since 2009 after Saudi Arabia and Russia resisted language regarding fossil fuel phase-outs. Saudi Arabia used the summit to announce a clean energy deal with the host, Türkiye, while simultaneously blocking broader commitments for other nations.

stories.title: COP31 concludes with no major agreement
stories.summary: The COP31 climate summit ended late Sunday without a major deal following deep divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance. The conclusion of the two-week event in Antalya coincided with global temperatures reaching 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels for six consecutive days.

stories.title: COP31 fails to adopt Antalya Pact
stories.summary: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference ended on 22 November without adopting the proposed Antalya Pact. Negotiations extended two days beyond the scheduled closing date, ultimately failing to bridge divisions between nations over the future of fossil fuels and international climate finance.

stories.title: Transport Infrastructure Ireland adopts circular economy strategy
stories.summary: Transport Infrastructure Ireland has launched a circular economy strategy to decarbonise its network by 2050. The agency aims to reduce resource consumption and extend the life of assets like roads and rail, framing the shift as a necessary step for economic and social competitiveness.

stories.title: India hosts conference on circular economy
stories.summary: The 11th International Conference on Waste to Worth Technologies in New Delhi focused on the transition from a linear to a circular economy. Officials noted that approximately 88,000 producers have contributed to the recycling of 560 lakh tonnes of waste across the country.

stories.title: EU advances circular economy regulations in 2026
stories.summary: Despite the failure of COP31 to address fossil fuel transitions, the European Union has progressed on decarbonisation and circular economy regulations this year. Half of the energy consumed in Europe remains imported fossil fuels, costing the bloc roughly 375 billion euros annually.

stories.title: Audit finds most local landfills non-compliant
stories.summary: An Auditor-General report found that 30 of 31 inspected local government landfill facilities failed to meet waste management licence conditions. The findings highlight the gap between zero-waste-to-landfill ambitions and the operational realities of managing waste disposal and purchasing contracts.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh adopts circular economy policy
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh has become the first Indian state to implement a circular economy policy. The framework aims to integrate sustainable resource management into the state's economic planning, marking a shift from traditional disposal models toward recycling and material recovery.

stories.title: Japan backs India’s circular economy drive | The Statesman Kolkata - newspaper - Magzter
Roadmap to Circular Economy Through Plastics Recycling | GCPSR 2026 - Plastemart.com
stories.summary: Join the Conference on Roadmap to Circular Economy Through Plastics Recycling on 9 December 2026 at The Leela, Mumbai. Explore advanced recycling, GST regulations, funding circularity, new polymers and sustainable packaging.

stories.title: Kenya launches 692 million dollar circular economy strategy
stories.summary: Kenya has unveiled a five-year strategy to mobilise 692 million dollars for circular economy initiatives. The plan targets five sectors, including agriculture and textiles, aiming to transform waste into economic resources while reducing pollution and creating jobs through repair, reuse, and recycling.

stories.title: TBC Uzbekistan releases first standalone sustainability report
stories.summary: TBC Uzbekistan has published its first standalone sustainability report for 2025, detailing its work on financial inclusion and social initiatives. The company previously relied on reports from its parent, TBC Bank Group. CEO Nika Kurdiani stated that sustainability is an integral part of the business model.

stories.title: Marcegaglia Steel secures 800 million euro in sustainability financing
stories.summary: Marcegaglia Steel has completed an 800 million euro sustainability-linked financing package. The deal involved a pool of banks including BNP Paribas, Intesa Sanpaolo and UniCredit, which served as coordinators for the arrangement. The funds are designated for the company's steel project in Fos-sur-Mer.

stories.title: TVO issues €500M green bond, cementing its nuclear-funding playbook - Dealroom
Primark reports 81 percent of materials are now preferred
stories.summary: Primark published its fifth annual sustainability report, stating 81 percent of its clothing now uses recycled or more sustainably sourced materials. The retailer noted that 6 percent of its total output is circular by design. A refreshed strategy is expected in 2027.

stories.title: BBVA launches transition debt framework for heavy industry
stories.summary: BBVA has launched a transition debt framework to fund emissions-intensive sectors like steel, cement and mining. The bank claims to be the first in Spain to implement such a dedicated system. It will issue bonds and loans to allocate capital toward eligible transition activities.

stories.title: LEGO Group to build renewable-powered factory in Portugal
stories.summary: The LEGO Group plans to open a factory in Estarreja, Portugal, by 2030. The site is intended to be 100 percent renewable-powered, with 80 percent of that energy generated on-site. It will employ over 1,000 people and serve as the company's eighth manufacturing facility worldwide.

stories.title: Primark reports 21 percent reduction in Scope 3 emissions
stories.summary: Primark has reported a 21 percent reduction in Scope 3 emissions, citing improved data accuracy from suppliers. The retailer is trialling new carbon accounting tools to move away from financial estimates. Circular design principles currently account for a single-digit share of total sales.

stories.title: GRIDSERVE secures 420 million pound refinancing package
stories.summary: EV charging network GRIDSERVE has secured a 420 million pound refinancing package. The deal includes a 75 million pound loan from the National Wealth Fund. The company stated the funding is intended to support the next phase of its growth.

stories.title: CMA CGM warns 2050 net zero target is currently unreachable
stories.summary: CMA CGM CEO Rodolphe Saadé stated the company will not reach its 2050 net zero target under current conditions. He cited geopolitical conflicts and a lack of alternative fuels as primary obstacles. The shipping industry faces an estimated 1 trillion dollar transition cost.

research.summary: The Chandrayaan-5/LuPEX mission is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions, JAXA, the Japanese space agency, unveiled the rover in Japan on November 25. Prototype of Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX rover unveiled

research.summary: Researchers uncovered two pathways for this: people unexposed to sugar early ate smaller quantities, and maintained healthier, more diverse diets five decades later, they also exhibited a longer leukocyte telomere, the protective DNA, protein cap at the ends of chromosomes inside a white blood cell length

research.summary: Be it in a forest or among the flowers in a garden, the air is enriched in volatile organic compounds, whose profiles climate change is beginning to alter. The changing scents of a warming world

research.title: Deep beneath Australia, hidden caves could unlock the secrets of alien worlds
research.summary: Scientists have solved the mystery of strange trenches scattered across Australia’s vast Nullarbor Plain, revealing an extensive hidden world beneath the surface. These subtle landscape features are created as deeply buried cave systems slowly collapse upward over millions of years. The discovery could help researchers locate unexplored caves.
